title: Engineering Term (v1)
description: A single entry in the Persian engineering terminology dictionary. Uniqueness of id/slug and referential integrity of related_terms are enforced by scripts/build_pages.py at build time.

id.description: Stable, unique identifier for the term (must never change once published).

term_fr.description: French equivalent (unverified translations must stay null).

term_de.description: German equivalent (unverified translations must stay null).

term_ar.description: Arabic equivalent (unverified translations must stay null).

pos.description: Part of speech of the Persian term.

domain.description: Engineering domains; every value must exist in data/terms/_meta.yaml.

definition_fa.description: Persian definition. Target: at least 50 characters; shorter definitions are flagged as warnings by the build until content review is complete.

related_terms.description: Ids of related terms; every value must reference an existing term id.

status.description: Editorial status. draft = not yet reviewed by a specialist.

reviewed_by.description: Name/handle of the specialist who reviewed this term (required once status != draft).

reviewed_at.description: ISO date of the last expert review (YYYY-MM-DD).

slug.description: Stable URL slug; must be unique across all data files.
